Backup & Restore

—

1. Backup — save your data to a file

2. Restore — bring data back from a backup file

Type RESTORE to confirm the replacement:

All data is stored only in this browser. It can be lost if browser data is cleared or the computer is changed, so download a backup regularly and keep a copy on a pen drive or cloud drive. A backup file contains the company PIN and all business data; do not share it with others.
